description: Main window: core APIs plus the folder-picker and save-as dialogs, and the window controls teaching mode uses (fullscreen, or a narrow always-on-top strip docked to a screen edge), the title bar's light or dark theme, and the window's background colour and showing it once the first screen is ready (it opens hidden, so a dark theme doesn't flash white). All file access goes through the app's own audited Rust commands.
